tools.name: finnhub_quote
tools.description: Real-time quote for a stock — current price (c), change (d), percent change (dp), high (h), low (l), open (o), previous close (pc) and unix timestamp (t). Finnhub REST: GET /quote.

tools.name: finnhub_symbol_search
tools.description: Search for stock symbols by name or ticker — returns best-matching symbols with descriptions and types. Finnhub REST: GET /search.

tools.name: finnhub_company_profile
tools.description: General company profile — name, country, currency, exchange, industry, market cap, share outstanding, IPO date, logo and more. Provide at least one of `symbol`, `isin` or `cusip`. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/profile2.

tools.name: finnhub_company_news
tools.description: Latest company news for a symbol over a date range (up to 1 year back). Finnhub REST: GET /company-news.

tools.name: finnhub_market_news
tools.description: General latest market news by category. Finnhub REST: GET /news.

tools.name: finnhub_basic_financials
tools.description: Key financial metrics for a company — valuation, margins, growth, per-share and 52-week ratios. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/metric.

tools.name: finnhub_recommendation_trends
tools.description: Analyst recommendation trends over time — counts of strong buy / buy / hold / sell / strong sell by period. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/recommendation.

tools.name: finnhub_earnings_surprises
tools.description: Historical quarterly EPS surprises — actual vs. estimated EPS by period. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/earnings.

tools.name: finnhub_price_target
tools.description: Analyst price targets for a symbol — high / low / median / mean target. Note: this is a premium-tier Finnhub endpoint (may return 403 on the free plan). Finnhub REST: GET /stock/price-target.

tools.name: finnhub_peers
tools.description: Peer companies for a symbol (same country and GICS sub-industry). Finnhub REST: GET /stock/peers.

tools.name: finnhub_insider_transactions
tools.description: Insider transactions (Form 3/4/5 filings) for a company, optionally within a date range. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/insider-transactions.

tools.name: finnhub_stock_symbols
tools.description: List all symbols supported on an exchange. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/symbol.

tools.name: finnhub_market_status
tools.description: Current market open/closed status and session for an exchange. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/market-status.

tools.name: finnhub_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming and historical earnings release calendar, optionally filtered by date range and/or symbol. Finnhub REST: GET /calendar/earnings.

tools.name: finnhub_ipo_calendar
tools.description: IPO calendar for a date range — upcoming and recent initial public offerings. Finnhub REST: GET /calendar/ipo.
